questiontext.text: Which of the following are constitutional rights and privileges enjoyed by Nigerian citizens? (Select all that apply)

generalfeedback.text: Voting, movement, and passports are citizen rights; breaking traffic laws is illegal.

questiontext.text: Identify two major distinctions between a citizen and an alien: (Select two)
